column3: BSB reads “the light of the sun, moon, and stars,” where the Hebrew lists “the sun and the light and the moon and the stars.”
Close to the Hebrew; “see dimly” renders “grow dim.”
Close to the Hebrew; “fades away” renders “becomes low.”
BSB renders “the grasshopper drags itself along” as “loses its spring” and “fails” as “shrivels”; “then” is added.
BSB adds “Remember Him” at the start, resuming verse 1.
BSB continues with “before,” where the Hebrew has “and”; “from which it came” renders “as it was.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to record” makes the second clause depend on “searched.”
BSB reads the masters of collections as “anthologies of the masters” and adds “driven by,” with “Shepherd” capitalized.
BSB renders “excess more than them” as “by these … be further warned.”
BSB adds “the whole duty of”; the Hebrew says “this is all of man.”
